_about: IMM recommendations carried in the 2025 State of the Market report, with PUCT Staff's position on each. Titles and Staff positions come from Staff's August 13, 2026 response (Project 34677, item 27). The status label and next step are my reading of that memo and of the filings and rule changes pulled by this dashboard.

report.label: 2025 State of the Market report, filed May 31, 2026

note: Staff's memo covers 12 recommendations: one new in 2025 and 11 carried over. It says the IMM retired five earlier recommendations.

recommendations.title: Redesign and improve the Firm Fuel Supply Service
recommendations.where: The commission adopted 16 TAC §25.520 at its January 29, 2026 open meeting without the changes the IMM sought. Staff says it is premature to amend the rule, and that the IMM's concerns about penalties and deployment criteria can be handled in ERCOT protocols.
recommendations.next: NPRR1335 carries the rule into ERCOT's protocols and is headed to the commission. ERCOT's Board report records that the IMM has no opinion on it.

recommendations.title: Define ancillary service demand curves by the marginal reliability value of each product
recommendations.where: At the August 20, 2026 open meeting the commission agreed that the demand curves no longer have to follow its 2019 guidance. Staff's August 21 memo records that ERCOT, the IMM and market participants may now propose changes.
recommendations.next: A protocol revision is needed to change the curves. None of the pending NPRRs pulled here does that yet. Parties in the offer cap review (Project 59550) are already raising demand curve design, and Base Power cites this recommendation directly.

recommendations.title: Set ancillary service methodology parameters by probabilistic risk
recommendations.where: Staff agrees some of ERCOT's parameters may be too conservative. On September 11 the commission let ERCOT keep its posted 2026 quantities instead of raising them by about 3,700 MW per hour. The IMM's August 20 comments list five parameters it wants in the 2027 methodology.
recommendations.next: The 2027 methodology needs commission approval. Last year's request was filed October 6 and decided November 6. No request for 2027 has been filed yet.

recommendations.title: Set the duration requirement for Non-Spin reserves to one hour
recommendations.where: NPRR1309, approved July 9, 2026, cut the requirement from four hours to two. Staff says going further is premature until there is data on the two-hour requirement.
recommendations.next: Revisit once NPRR1309 has operating history.

recommendations.title: Implement a process to mitigate market power at system and zonal levels
recommendations.where: Staff took comments in the wholesale market power review. Most commenters said the three-step test is too conceptual to evaluate. Staff asks the IMM for a more complete specification with examples.
recommendations.next: A fuller proposal from the IMM would restart this one.

recommendations.title: Establish real-time offer requirements, penalties and proxy pricing
recommendations.where: Staff supports flagging proxy offers in dispatch data so the IMM can monitor them. Staff says it has seen no new IMM analysis showing proxy offers have harmed market outcomes since real-time co-optimization began.
recommendations.next: Analysis of proxy offers under real-time co-optimization would answer Staff's point.

recommendations.title: Implement a multi-interval real-time market
recommendations.where: Staff cites ERCOT's 2017 study: about $20 to $25 million to implement against less than $200,000 in production cost savings. Staff says the IMM has not provided new results showing larger benefits.
recommendations.next: Staff recommends ERCOT and stakeholders decide whether a new cost-benefit assessment is justified.

recommendations.title: Implement an uncertainty product
recommendations.where: The commission approved NPRR1309 creating Dispatchable Reliability Reserve Service with the design principles the IMM suggested. ERCOT expects to launch it in 2028 or 2029.
recommendations.next: Two follow-on revisions are pending at PRS: NPRR1310 and NPRR1340. The IMM commented on NPRR1310 in February 2026.

recommendations.title: Reconfigure load zones to reflect prevailing congestion patterns
recommendations.where: Staff agrees load and generation have shifted since 2003 but doubts zones can be studied well while load growth, interconnections and transmission buildout are all in flux.
recommendations.next: Staff treats this as a longer-term efficiency goal.

recommendations.title: Implement a point-to-point obligation bid fee
recommendations.where: ERCOT filed NPRR1343 on June 30, 2026 to charge a fee on inefficient hourly bids in the day-ahead market. Staff recommends implementing it as soon as practicable.
recommendations.next: NPRR1343 is at PRS, which meets October 14. The IMM filed comments on it on October 2.

recommendations.title: Price ancillary services based on the shadow price of procuring each service
recommendations.where: Staff agrees, and points to the commission's ancillary services study finding that separate prices for sub-types would likely help. The finding says to consider it after real-time co-optimization has stabilized.
recommendations.next: Staff says ERCOT and stakeholders should take it up as priorities allow.

recommendations.title: Move transmission cost allocation away from the four coincident peak method
recommendations.where: The commission proposed amendments to 16 TAC §25.192 and §25.193 and new §25.252 on July 9, 2026. Comments closed August 11 with more than 50 filed, including the IMM's. Staff expects adoption by the end of 2026.
recommendations.next: Watch for Staff's recommended adoption order in Project 58000.
